page.layout: One title page: a large heading at the top, several centred lines of smaller type below it, an oval engraved emblem in the middle, and a short imprint line at the foot. No margins or columns. The library shelf mark at the lower left is excluded.
page.notes: The page is a title page, so every printed line is an <l>. Most lines are too faded or stained to read; only the large heading "APOLOGETICVS" is partly legible, and it is marked [?]. The small lines, the lines of the imprint and the lines beside the emblem are illegible and are given only as approximate lengths. The imprint at the foot is a guess: "Amstelodami" is not certain. The engraved oval emblem in the centre is an ornament, not text. The printed "SCS #1345" at the lower left is a library shelf mark, so it is left out. Some marks at the top may be show-through from the reverse page and are not included.
